transport: identical
scanner: none
constructs: none. A document that writes about ExactTeX shows its tokens in a code
  font, and `\texttt`, `\verb` and `verbatim` are exclusion regions in §8, so every
  reserved sequence here stays ordinary bytes. `\figure{w}` with braces is not a
  typed block either: only the reserved name immediately followed by `(` opens one.
  This fixture pins the decision recorded in `scanner/tables.rs`, that `\texttt` is
  deliberately absent from the prose commands, so that converting it can never
  corrupt a document that documents the language.
